digest.component_or_area: Gerrit Verify → External Integration Tests workflow boundary; ADR architecture decision
propositions: Gerrit Verify currently runs complete real-Pandoc corpus conversions on every CI invocation, consuming 184+ seconds of the macOS critical path in two phases alone.
ADR 0095 mandates live real-binary conversion assertions for every test case, creating a testing boundary that conflicts with moving expensive corpus replay to external integration.

The approved design preserves three representative live corpus bodies (code_arrow, table, prose) and compact pin/provenance probes in Gerrit Verify while moving complete real-Pandoc replay to a dedicated weekly/manual external-integration job.
The external-integration.yml workflow is currently Ubuntu-only and requires a future implementation to add a matrix job with ubuntu-latest and macos-latest runners for full platform coverage.
ADR 0096 narrows the supersession of ADR 0095 to the test execution boundary only, preserving all production renderer invariants, platform handling, fallback behavior, and safety assertions.
